description: This file implements a client for interacting with a documentation-based GPT-like language model via an external process. It includes functions to start the process, send prompts, handle responses, and manage process lifecycle, along with data structures for messaging and responses.

classes.name: docsPiClient
classes.description: A client struct managing the external process for documentation-based prompts, including IO pipes, channels for events, locking, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: piEvent
classes.description: A struct representing events emitted by the process, with a type and raw message.

classes.name: agentEndPayload
classes.description: Payload structure for the end of an agent session, containing message history.

classes.name: rpcResponse
classes.description: Represents a response to RPC commands with ID, type, command, success status, and error message.

classes.name: agentMessage
classes.description: A message sent by or to the agent, including role, content, and optional stop or error reasons.

classes.name: contentBlock
classes.description: Structure for content blocks in responses, with type and text.

methods.name: startDocsPiClient
methods.description: Initializes and starts the external process for documentation prompts, setting environment variables and pipes.

methods.name: Prompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt message to the external process and waits for a response or error, returning the assistant's reply.

methods.name: Stderr
methods.description: Returns accumulated standard error output from the process.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Gracefully terminates the external process, with fallback kill after timeout.

methods.name: captureStderr
methods.description: Reads and buffers stderr output from the process.

methods.name: readStdout
methods.description: Reads and processes stdout stream, dispatching JSON-encoded event messages.

methods.name: extractTranslationResult
methods.description: Extracts text content from the agent's final message payload.

methods.name: extractContentText
methods.description: Parses message content, which can be raw text or structured blocks, returning aggregated plain text.

methods.name: decodeRpcResponse
methods.description: Decodes raw JSON message into rpcResponse struct.

methods.name: getDocsPiAgentDir
methods.description: Determines a directory path for agent files, creating it if necessary.
